p6_b0.ocr: Understanding the distribution of blood pressure levels across various populations is crucial for assessing cardiovascular health and informing public health strategies. Notably, the metrics for systolic blood pressure (mm Hg) and diastolic blood pressure (mm Hg) reveal significant variations across these regions, which may be influenced by environmental, lifestyle, and genetic factors unique to each population.
